name: webrtc-iot-monitor-dependencies
description: Required dependencies for WebRTC IoT Monitoring System

instructions: Add these dependencies to your existing package.json
For Expo managed workflow, also run: npx expo install expo-av
Update app.json/app.config.js with required permissions (see WEBRTC_IOT_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md)
For bare React Native, follow react-native-webrtc linking instructions: https://github.com/react-native-webrtc/react-native-webrtc/blob/master/Documentation/BasicInstallation.md

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera for video streaming

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access (not used but required by WebRTC)
